summary: Comprehensive testing of Organization Structure feature - Position Hierarchy, Department Hierarchy, Org Chart, Teams. Backend: 19/19 tests passed. Frontend: All 4 tabs working with view toggles. Fixed critical bug with SelectItem empty value causing modal crash.

endpoints_tested: GET /api/hr/departments - Returns 13 departments with parent_department_id and hierarchy info
GET /api/hr/departments/{id}/hierarchy - Returns parent chain, children, and teams
verified_features: Department hierarchy endpoint returns parent_chain, children, and teams
Can update department parent and description

endpoints_tested: GET /api/hr/positions - Returns 9 positions with reporting_position_id hierarchy
GET /api/hr/org-chart?root_id={id} - Returns tree from specific employee
verified_features: Org chart returns nested children structure
Nodes include id, name, title, department_name, email

endpoints_tested: GET /api/hr/teams - Returns teams grouped by department

tabs_verified: Org Chart - Interactive tree with Expand All/Collapse All, Employee Details panel
Departments (13) - Hierarchy view with expand/collapse, Cards view toggle
Position Hierarchy (9) - CEO→VP→Director→Manager chain with color-coded level badges

modals_tested: Add Position modal - Level dropdown, Department, Reports To Position
Add Department modal - Parent Department dropdown, Department Head dropdown, Color picker
Add Team modal - Department dropdown, Team Lead dropdown

bugs_fixed.description: SelectItem with empty string value crashes React app
bugs_fixed.root_cause: RadixUI SelectItem does not allow value='' (empty string) - it throws 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'
bugs_fixed.fix_applied: Changed all SelectItem value='' to value='none' and updated handleSubmit functions to convert 'none' back to null before API calls

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: SelectItem empty value bug in all 3 modals (Position, Department, Team)
Org Chart with drill-down and employee selection panel working correctly

seed_data_used.positions: 9 default positions (CEO, VP, Director, Senior Manager, Manager, Team Lead, Senior Executive, Executive, Associate)
seed_data_used.departments: 13 company departments (Warehouse, Fulfilment, Delivery, Stylist, Marketing, Customer Support, etc.)
